title: "check_for_prereg_updates"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-19"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
```

# Load data

```{r}
master_list <- read.csv("MASTER_to_code.csv") |>
  filter(exclude != "Excluded") |>
  select(article_number, DOI, all_registration_urls) |>
  mutate(osf_id = str_extract(all_registration_urls, "osf\\.io/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)", group = 1))
```

# Query OSF API

`/schema_responses/` returns one entry per version of the registration form. More than 1 means it was formally updated via OSF's Registration Update system.

```{r}
# osf_token <- "YOUR_TOKEN_HERE"  # uncomment for higher rate limits

check_registration <- function(osf_id, article_number) {
  if (is.na(osf_id)) {
    return(tibble(article_number = article_number, osf_id = NA,
                  n_schema_responses = NA, was_updated = NA, status = "no_id"))
  }

  resp <- request(paste0("https://api.osf.io/v2/registrations/", osf_id, "/schema_responses/")) |>
    req_headers(Accept = "application/json") |>
    # req_auth_bearer_token(osf_token) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 2) |>
    req_error(is_error = \(r) FALSE) |>
    req_perform()

  if (resp_status(resp) != 200) {
    return(tibble(article_number = article_number, osf_id = osf_id,
                  n_schema_responses = NA, was_updated = NA,
                  status = paste("http_error", resp_status(resp))))
  }

  n <- resp_body_json(resp)$links$meta$total

  tibble(
    article_number     = article_number,
    osf_id             = osf_id,
    n_schema_responses = n,
    was_updated        = n > 1,
    status             = "ok"
  )
}
```

# Run for all registrations

```{r}
results <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(master_list)), function(i) {
  row <- master_list[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] article %s (osf_id: %s)\n",
              i, nrow(master_list), row$article_number, row$osf_id))
  result <- check_registration(row$osf_id, row$article_number)
  Sys.sleep(0.5)
  result
})
```

# Summary

```{r}
cat("Total checked:", sum(results$status == "ok"), "\n")
cat("Was updated:  ", sum(results$was_updated, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Errors:       ", sum(results$status != "ok"), "\n")

results |> filter(was_updated) |> select(article_number, osf_id, n_schema_responses)

write.csv(results, "registration_update_check.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
